findings.summary: toggleSaveSpot calls POST /saves/toggle instead of the specified POST /api/users/favorites/:spotId. If the backend only exposes the specified route, all bookmark actions will silently fail. Align client.js with the actual backend route or confirm /saves/toggle is a valid alias.

The dashboard has no 'My Spots' sidebar entry and no panel for displaying the user's submitted spots. The task explicitly requires this. Add an activeNav === 'MySpots' sidebar button and a corresponding panel that fetches the user's own place submissions.

postReview writes to /spots/:id/reviews but fetchReviews reads from /reviews?placeId=. These are different URL shapes for the same resource. Confirm both backend routes exist; if reviews are under /spots/:id/reviews, fetchReviews should use that path too.
